findings.title: Timeshift's hourly check runs every hour, not only from 09:00 to 21:00

doc.quote: `0 9-21 * * *`; restricted on 2026-09-12 and verified on the host

findings.reason: The manual says /etc/cron.d/timeshift-hourly is 0 9-21 * * *, but the installed file has 0 * * * *, so the check also runs at night.
